`percentOf` now rounds half up to the nearest cent, so 19.99 EUR at 7% gives 1.40 tax instead of 1.39.

Decisions: exported the existing matcher as `matchPath(pattern, path)` and moved the route loop into a private `find`; kept the 404 in handlers.ts ("invoice not found") out of scope, since it is a different response; pinned the malformed `%` param case, which still makes `handle` reject with a URIError outside the 500 path
Comments: none
Waivers: none
Commit: refactor(http): extract matchPath and single 404/500 builders in Router   (staged; your answer commits it)

The last decision is a bug that already exists, and this change leaves it as it is. A request like `GET /invoices/%E0%A4%A` throws before the handler's try block. `server.ts` does not catch the error, so the real server gets an unhandled rejection instead of sending a 400 or 500. Fixing it would change behaviour, so it would need its own request.

[a] accept   [p] accept and publish to artifacts/reports/invoice-pricing-totals-discount-tax.md   [d] deeper pass   [x] reject: <why>

`computeTotals` in `src/domain/invoice.ts:22` adds up the line subtotals (`quantity * unitPriceCents`). It then subtracts the volume discount from `applyStuff` (`src/domain/pricing.ts:20`), which is based on the number of lines: 10 or more lines get 5% and 25 or more get 10% (`LADDER`, `src/domain/pricing.ts:10-13`). Tax is added after the discount, on the discounted amount, at the configured 7% (`src/config.ts:14`, `data/config.json:4`). Rounding happens in one place only: `Math.floor` in `percentOf` (`src/domain/money.ts:17`), applied once to the whole-invoice discount and once to the tax. Because it rounds down, a 1005-cent subtotal gets a 50-cent discount, not 50.25.

This came from a quick first pass of the code. The tests were not read, so it is still unconfirmed whether they check these thresholds and the rounding.
